note: Scale training across GPUs and clusters.

children.note: Cluster runtime with PyTorch (2.12.0), scikit-learn (1.7.2), XGBoost (3.2.0), TensorFlow (legacy on Runtime 17.3 LTS only), GPU drivers; Spark MLlib support.
Managed serverless GPU compute: 1×A10 (24 GB), 1×H100 (80 GB), or 8×H100 (per GPU). Pay-per-minute, scale-to-zero. Notebook and CLI access. Public Preview status Oct 2026.
Framework-agnostic distributed training orchestration; multi-GPU/multi-node support for PyTorch, TensorFlow; integrates with Ray Data and Ray Tune for end-to-end pipelines.
Distributed parallel hyperparameter trials with ASHA early stopping; per-trial GPU reservations; integrates with MLflow for experiment tracking and child-run logging.
Launcher for distributed PyTorch via Spark cluster resources; wraps torch.distributed.run; minimal migration from existing DDP code; Spark 3.4+ / Runtime 13.0 ML+.
Distributed classification, regression, clustering, collaborative filtering; pyspark.ml API for scalable ML on massive datasets; dimensionality reduction and feature engineering.
ZeRO sharding (stages 1-3), optimizer/gradient partitioning, CPU offload; via TorchDistributor on classic compute or AI Runtime; Llama 2 7B fine-tuning examples provided.
Stage 1: optimizer sharding; Stage 2: gradient sharding; Stage 3: parameter sharding for extreme scale.
Partition optimizer states across GPUs to reduce memory per device.
Distribute gradients across workers; each worker computes a subset.
Offload optimizer and gradient states to CPU memory for further memory savings.
Notebook decorator for single-node multi-GPU training (DDP, FSDP, DeepSpeed); serverless execution on AI Runtime; replaces TorchDistributor for compatible workloads without Spark.
